onboardingWelcomeTitle:
Ekwentị gị bụ 
 ihe nkesa Minecraft
onboardingWelcomeSubtitle:
Nabata sava Java Edition n'efu. 
 Enweghị PC achọrọ. Soro onye ọ bụla gwuo egwu.
onboardingStep1Body: Akwụkwọ na-agba ọsọ na ekwentị gị ma na-eji ebe nchekwa ị nwere.
onboardingStep2Body: PocketCraft na-enye gị adreesị relay pụrụ iche nke ndị enyi nwere ike jikọọ na ya.
onboardingStep3Body: Ndị na-egwu mbipụta Java na-ejikọta ogologo oge site na relay na obere esemokwu.
onboardingImportTitle: Ịga Aternos ma ọ bụ Minehut?
onboardingImportSubtitle: Weta ụwa gị, plugins na hazie gị. Enweghị mmalite ọzọ.
onboardingImportWorldBody: Mbupụ na Aternos, dobe ebe nchekwa na PocketCraft, wee gaa n'ihu.
onboardingImportPluginsBody: Tinyegharịa otu faịlụ .jar ahụ. Ngwa mgbakwunye gị na-aga.
onboardingImportConfigBody: server.properties, whitelist, na onye ọrụ ohere na-anọgide na-adịghị.
onboardingFeaturesSubtitle: Ọ bụghị ngwa ewepụrụ. Nke a bụ ezigbo ngwa ihe nkesa.
onboardingFeaturesBanner: Ihe niile ị chọrọ n'otu ebe

onboardingCrossPlayNoExtraApp: Enweghị ngwa mgbakwunye maka ndị egwuregwu

onboardingCrossPlayExperimental: ⚠️ Njirimara nnwale - Gwuo n'ikike nke aka gị __ỌHỤRỤ ỌHỤRỤ____ ỌZỌ__ Egwuregwu-egwu ka na-arụ ọrụ. Nsogbu na nkwụsi ike nwere ike ime n'ihi na akwadobeghi njirimara a. Jiri n'ihe egwu nke gị.
onboardingRegionSubtitle: Họrọ ihe nkesa relay kacha nso ndị egwuregwu gị. Ị nwere ike ịgbanwe nke a ma emechaa site na dashboard kwa.
